_readme: v8 composite confidence score weights. These are STARTING PRIORS, not settled truth - breakout_or_trendline_signal is deliberately low because our own backtest-results.json showed the raw signal barely beats a coin flip (53.3% vs 51.2%). idiosyncratic_quality is high because it's what actually flipped the OP and ARB verdicts in review. Edit any value here to override the code default without redeploying breakout_check.py - a partial file only overrides the keys it names, everything else falls back to the code default. Once agent-room-log.json has ~15-20 entries, these should be recalibrated from real outcomes instead of left as opinion.
